Maria (CSM): Morning team — kickoff for Polaris early-access dedicated pool bring-up tomorrow 09:00 PT. Main asks: quota plan, autoscale probe, and one end-to-end smoke/load test. Can we confirm owners?
Sam (Eng): I can own the autoscale probe and load test harness. Need final quota numbers from CS + expected QPS shape.
Maria (CSM): Customer committed to 250 qps sustained, spikes to 1.2k qps for short bursts. They want 99th perc latency < 350ms. Renewal is in 6 months; failing this run raises risk.
Oliver (SRE): Noted. For Dedicated we should reserve 20% headroom above sustained to account for cold-starts and degradation. Suggest quota = 300 sustained, burst cap 1.5k. Also confirm GPU type (A10G vs H100) — affects batching/latency.
Sam (Eng): Polaris asked for A10G pool. I'll tune batching accordingly. For autoscale probe, plan: ramp from 10 qps -> sustained 300 qps over 10m, then 3 spike blasts at 1.2k for 2m each with 5m cool-downs. If 99p exceeds 350ms or error rate > 1% we abort.
Jess (PM): Add a canary route using model v1.2 (quantized) and a fallback to hosted small model if latency fails. Also capture token cost delta in the run.
Maria (CSM): I'll coordinate timing with Polaris ops and schedule enablement session for their devs after the run. They want a short ops runbook and an on-call handoff.
Sam (Eng): Load test harness snippet (k6 JS) I'll run from our perf cluster:

```js
import http from 'k6/http';
import {sleep} from 'k6';
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: 'status check'}), {headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer $TEST_KEY','Content-Type':'application/json'}});
  sleep(1);
}
```

I'll parameterize concurrency and duration.
Oliver (SRE): Please add synthetics to monitor KV cache hit ratio and queue depth. If queue depth > 50 for 30s, trigger rollback to hosted fallback.
Maria (CSM): Who will capture feedback and postmortem? I'll own customer-facing feedback + renewal notes; need an internal postmortem owner for infra learnings.
Sam (Eng): I'll take the infra postmortem. Plan to collect perf traces, p95/p99, error logs, and a runbook action list.
LoadTestBot: scheduled run created: run_id=polaris-3789012345; start=2026-05-02T16:00:00Z; owner=@sam_eng
Jess (PM): Great. Final checklist before tomorrow: 1) Quota ticket created & approved (Maria) 2) Tests staged (Sam) 3) SRE alerting in place (Oliver) 4) Customer enablement invite sent (Maria) 5) Fallback policy validated (Sam + Oliver).
Maria (CSM): I'll file the quota ticket now and ping Polaris ops about the invite. If anyone finds gaps, flag them here — otherwise we proceed. :thumbsup:
Sam (Eng): I'll post the exact k6 runner command and env vars in the run thread an hour before start.
Oliver (SRE): I'll add dashboard links and alert runbooks to the ticket.
Maria (CSM): Thanks — see you all tomorrow.
